name: portal
description: Portal-OS v4.4 - Multi-domain operating substrate deployed on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:copy
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p dist && (cp src/index.html dist/index.html 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp src/interactive.html dist/interactive.html 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r src/public dist/public 2>/dev/null || true)
